title: Quartz Cave
body:
Description


The Quartz Cave is a location in Mike's Mines containing exclusively Marble nodes. The Quartz Cave is located at the far left of Mike's Mines. The cave contains giant quartz crystals with a giant pit in the middle. You can drive down this pit to reach it's bottom, and at the bottom, the giant crystals become pink and marble nodes gain an increased chance of containing Rosa Flama Quartz.
